verdict.rationale: Trello's own support documentation lists an "Import data into Trello" capability among its Power-Up features, so a first-party import path exists. The pack gives only that bare title, with no detail on source tools, formats or what data carries over. Missing for 10: supported source tools and file formats, scope of data mapped (cards, lists, members, attachments, history), step-by-step import docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a switch-over import.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can import my data from another tool when switching over
